Master List of Free Printables & Plant Spotlights

This list will help you locate which blog posts contain free plant spotlights, “cheat sheets”, reference charts, labels, and other various printables that have been added to my website over the years.

Printing Tips: For best results, print from a computer or laptop. Printing from a phone occasionally results in partially printed pages or printing errors. Be sure you’re opening and printing the actual high quality PDF and not just a photo of the printable.

Table of Contents
  • Foraging & Harvesting Printables
  • Ingredient Info & Usage Sheets
  • Soapmaking
  • Labels
  • Natural Remedies Guides & Cheat Sheets
  • Natural Cleaning Recipes
  • Plant Reference Sheets ("Things to Make")
  • Unruly Gardening Plant Sheets
  • Salves & Balms Guide, Worksheet & Chart

Here are the blog posts that have printables in them; I will update as more are added.

Foraging & Harvesting Printables

Differences Between Henbit, Creeping Charlie & Purple Dead Nettle – this blog post contains a visual cheat sheet that helps you identify and sort out three commonly confused spring weeds

How to Harvest & Dry Flowers & Herbs – contains a two page printable “cheat sheet” of 23 herbs and flowers you might come across in your garden or around your home + project ideas

Ingredient Info & Usage Sheets

Rose Clay Info – all about rose kaolin clay, plus usage rates & tips when making natural skincare, remedies & soapmaking; plus a two page printable.

Soapmaking

Soapmaking 101 Printable Checklist – contains a four page printable that takes you step by step through making batches of handmade soap

Essential Oils for Soapmaking Chart – has a 3 page reference chart detailing 30 essential oils you can use in soap, plus their suggested usage rates

Labels

Printable Tincture Labels – contains circular and square labels for jars and dropper bottles

Natural Remedies Guides & Cheat Sheets

Homemade Liniments – guide to making your own liniments, plus formula, recipes, plus a two page printable cheat sheet

Summer Remedies Cheat Sheet – printable reference sheet with some of my favorite summer remedies for things like bug bites and sunburn.

Cold & Flu Cheat Sheet – a quick reference for the next time a cold or flu strikes your house

Natural Cleaning Recipes

12 Natural Cleaning Recipe Cheat Sheet – a printable reference that you can stick to your fridge or cleaning supply cabinet

Plant Reference Sheets (“Things to Make”)

12+ Things to Do with Lemon Balm – this blog post contains over a dozen things to make with lemon balm from your garden, plus a printable cheat sheet about lemon balm

12+ Things to Make with Dandelion Flowers – how to use dandelion flowers to make useful things such as: salve, soap, dandelion jelly, and more, plus a quick reference sheet about dandelions

9+ Things to Make with Purple Dead Nettle – creative and practical things to make with purple dead nettle, plus a printable plant cheat sheet

10 Things to Make with Lavender – useful and pretty things to make with lavender, plus a reference sheet you can save or print out

12+ Things to Make with Roses – over a dozen creative & useful projects using roses; plus a rose plant spotlight printable

10+ Things to Make with Calendula Flowers – how to use calendula in skincare, soap, and for health; plus a calendula printable cheat sheet

8 Things to Make with Lilacs – recipes and remedies using lilac flowers, plus a printable reference sheet all about lilacs

10+ Things to Make with Violets – pretty & practical things to make with violets, plus a violet plant printable

10+ Things to Make with Fresh Mint – several skincare & soap projects, and natural remedies using mint, plus an accompanying printable

10+ Things to Make with Plantain – turn a common backyard weed into lip balm, lotion bars, tincture, and more! also includes a plantain printable

10+ Things to Make with Chamomile – recipes and projects using soothing chamomile flowers, plus a printable all about chamomile

Unruly Gardening Plant Sheets

(These are from my family’s blog, Unruly Gardening, which will be merged with this site some time in 2026 or 2027.)

Foraging & Using Goldenrod – foraging tips, plus remedies and recipes, and a quick reference sheet

How to Harvest, Preserve & Use Elderberries – a free printable “cheat sheet” of elderberry remedies & recipes

Salves & Balms Guide, Worksheet & Chart

This is a free salve making guide I give out – you can optionally use the form to join my newsletter list, or you can just grab and go! I currently send email newsletters about once per month, but they’re also archived on Substack if you’d rather read them that way.

Jan

author, herbalist, soapmaker

Jan Berry is a writer, herbalist, soapmaker, avid forager, and bestselling author of The Big Book of Homemade Products, Simple & Natural Soapmaking, and Easy Homemade Melt & Pour Soaps. She lives in the Blue Ridge Mountains with her family and a menagerie of animals, where she enjoys brainstorming creative things to make with the flowers and weeds that grow around her.
